coverage.why: Measured 2026-10-05 (plan 101 sweep 9): 72.7% of lines and 67.6% of functions, with the e2e suites' own fixtures excluded (see exclude) — they run in the e2e step against a real browser, and a browser-side helper added for #507's proof had pushed functions to 64.9%. Before that, 2026-10-02: 71.5% / 65.0% over 138 source files. What is not run: page renders (app/posts/[id]/page.tsx, site/pricing/page.tsx, site/blog/[slug]/page.tsx), the event handlers and mount() of every island (a unit test drives them through the built chunk, never this source), posts/service.ts past its first branch, and digest/jobs.ts, which the job suite runs and the unit suite does not. Each slice that adds a unit test raises this floor in the same commit.

exclude.why: the e2e suites' fixtures and drivers: each runs inside the e2e step against a real browser and a booted app, never under a unit test, so counting them weighed browser-side helpers (page-reads.ts, echo-hold.ts) against the unit floor
